//targetDates: The week of July 6, 2026 (Mon-Sat). Any of these opening up triggers notify + auto-book. Add 2026-07-12 if you also want Sunday.
//autoBook: true = actually reserve the slot. false = notify only. Controlled per-run by the AUTO_BOOK secret/var; this is the fallback.
//preSteps: Ordered clicks needed to reach the calendar (service, stylist, etc.). Each step is a Playwright selector or 'text=...'. Leave empty if the calendar shows immediately. Tune after the first run using the uploaded screenshots.
//selectors: Optional overrides. Empty string = use the built-in generic heuristic. Fill these in only if the first run's screenshots show the heuristic missed something.
//booking: Used to fill the booking form. Non-secret fields here; secret/PII fields come from env (CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_PHONE, PET_NAME, NOTIFY_TO).
